Iceland Summons US Ambassador After Trump Posts Map Showing Iceland as US Territory

2026-09-08 Agence France-Presse Trump, map, Iceland, US ambassador, expansionism, Greenland, Google Maps, Lake America, cartography, geopolitics, territorial claims, Truth Social
Read the source article

Quick summary

Iceland has summoned the US ambassador after President Trump posted a map on Truth Social showing the entire North American continent — including Iceland — covered by the American flag, escalating a series of cartographic provocations that now intersect with Google Maps' renaming of Lake Ontario to "Lake America."

Key takeaways

  • Iceland's Foreign Minister Thorgerdur Katrin Gunnarsdottir summoned US Ambassador Billy Long to signal that the image was "totally inappropriate"
  • Trump posted the map on Truth Social showing the US, Central America, Canada, Greenland, and Iceland covered by the American flag, with no caption
  • The incident follows Trump's persistent territorial ambitions regarding Greenland, a Danish autonomous territory whose coast is less than 300 km from Iceland
  • Trump previously confused Greenland with Iceland in January 2026
  • Iceland has been independent since 1944, has no army, and relies on NATO and a 1951 bilateral defense agreement with the US for security
  • Icelandic voters rejected EU accession negotiations in an August 29 referendum, maintaining their balance of European economic integration and Atlantic defense posture
  • The map incident coincides with Google Maps displaying "Lake America" instead of Lake Ontario within the United States
